RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: words said in front of everyone
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A colonist who was really insulted brings it before the lord.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} has not let it go: {OTHER_labelShort} said it out loud, in front of others, and everyone heard. {PETITIONER_labelShort} wants it said here, before the lord, that it was a lie.\n\nHow does the lord rule?

li.label: Punish them both for the spectacle
Bind {OTHER_labelShort} to the post for the lie
li.pastLabel: {OTHER_labelShort} bound to the post for it

RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: blows exchanged
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: Two colonists who really came to blows are called to answer for it.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText: It came to blows between {PETITIONER_labelShort} and {OTHER_labelShort}, and the colony had to pull them apart. {PETITIONER_labelShort} came out of it worse and wants the lord to say who was in the wrong.\n\nHow does the lord rule?

li.label: Let them settle it with their fists

RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: a life owed
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A colonist demands justice for a relative or friend killed by another colonist.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} stands before the court and asks for the only thing that would settle it: {OTHER_labelShort} took someone from {PETITIONER_objective}, and still walks the colony every day. The whole hall knows it is true. Nobody knows what it is worth.\n\nHow does the lord rule?

li.label: Have {OTHER_labelShort} flogged before the court
li.pastLabel: the blood price paid under the lash

li.label: Rule the matter closed and forbid revenge

RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: a hand that slipped
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A colonist maimed on the operating table wants the surgeon answered for.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} went under {OTHER_labelShort}'s knife and came back out worse than {PETITIONER_pronoun} went in. {OTHER_labelShort} calls it bad luck. {PETITIONER_labelShort} calls it something else, and wants the lord to call it by its name.\n\nHow does the lord rule?

li.label: Rule it bad luck, and warn {PETITIONER_labelShort} off
Bind {OTHER_labelShort} to the post for the hand that slipped
li.pastLabel: the surgeon bound to the post

RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: a heart turned away
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A colonist really rebuffed, cheated on or left brings it to court.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} has brought a matter of the heart before the court, which is either very brave or very unwise. {OTHER_labelShort} turned {PETITIONER_objective} away, and now the whole colony gets to watch it happen a second time.\n\nHow does the lord rule?

li.label: Rule that the court does not sit on hearts
